prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic live-action footage, fixed close camera with the physical cause visible. Use naturally recorded, close and detailed location/foley audio synchronized to the visible motion. Perform three short distinct occurrences at roughly 0.8, 2.5 and 4.3 seconds; each should vary slightly in force, timing and texture and then stop. Leave a quiet gap and complete the natural decay between occurrences. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, electronic synthesizer, chiptune, 8-bit sound, UI sounds, cartoon sounds, reverb wash, or added cinematic riser. No montage, no cuts, no titles. At an outdoor archery practice range, a real bow shoots an arrow across the frame into a dense straw target. Capture the taut string release, brief air pass and dry fibrous target impact. Use a light recurve bow and a thin arrow: soft short string twang, fine fast air pass, delicate fibrous tick on the straw target.
prompt_records.evidence: generation prompt recorded with crop SHA

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic live-action footage, fixed close camera with the physical cause visible. Use naturally recorded, close and detailed location/foley audio synchronized to the visible motion. Perform three short distinct occurrences at roughly 0.8, 2.5 and 4.3 seconds; each should vary slightly in force, timing and texture and then stop. Leave a quiet gap and complete the natural decay between occurrences. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, electronic synthesizer, chiptune, 8-bit sound, UI sounds, cartoon sounds, reverb wash, or added cinematic riser. No montage, no cuts, no titles. At an outdoor archery practice range, a real bow shoots an arrow across the frame into a dense straw target. Capture the taut string release, brief air pass and dry fibrous target impact. Use a light recurve bow and a thin arrow: soft short string twang, fine fast air pass, delicate fibrous tick on the straw target.

Fixed camera, the target is centered, action plays in real time at normal physical speed, not slow motion; no montage or cuts. Create realistic, clear, impactful physical Foley synchronized to visible action even though visuals are game-like. No background music, score, singing, speech, narration, chiptune, 8-bit sound, cartoon or synthesized game audio. A sustained forceful jet of water starts promptly, hits and washes the center of the target, then naturally subsides. Realistic broad water pressure and splashing, not synthesized or chiptune. On the reference animation clock the first visible water is at 0.0417 s; strongest visible brightness at 0.2917 s (a visual measure, not an audio impact cue); largest visible area at 1.0417 s; visible release ends about 1.875 s and the full timeline ends 2.4167 s. Keep the sound continuous over the visible action and let the water tail end naturally. No separately invented impact beats. These exact times are target animation metadata, not proof the generated audio conforms. The supplied image shows actual animation frame 4 at 24 FPS, so the video begins at animation 0.166667 seconds; subtract that offset from the animation-clock targets above to place them relative to video start.

Show all motion and sound in natural real time at plausible physical speed, with decisive, fast action appropriate to the event. No slow motion, speed ramp, frozen tableau, exaggerated suspended particles or stretched impact. Maintain the explicitly requested event timing and natural sound decay; keep audio synchronized to the visible action.

For a new target, re-anchor the main onset and audition material/scale; matching peak dBFS alone is insufficient.
avoid_when: A crop carrying several audible events must not be repeated once per hit.
Source-specific rejected contexts are not automatically reusable.

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic single continuous live-action scene, fixed close camera with a believable physical sound source visibly moving in sync. Capture bold, physical, close-miked sound with assertive attack, convincing mass and clear texture: fast pressure movement, a decisive sharp transient, weighty mid/low body and a natural short decay appropriate to the material. Strong impact and realistic dynamic range without digital clipping, harsh distortion, cartoon exaggeration or synthetic tones. Three short separated takes of the SAME physical event, with varying force and texture, not copies: weak at about 0.80 seconds, medium at 2.50 seconds, strong at 4.20 seconds. Each take has its own explicit duration below; keep the gaps genuinely quiet and never overlap adjacent tails. Sounds must match what is visible and stop naturally before the next take. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, chiptune, 8-bit sounds, UI sounds, artificial whooshes, cinematic risers, titles, edits or montage. In a real electrical-effects test chamber, a visible short arc snaps between electrodes. Capture its dry electrical crackle and a brief close snap, with no electronic tone. The physical transient peaks at 0.80 / 2.50 / 4.20 seconds, and the complete incoming movement and natural tail last approximately 250 / 380 / 550 milliseconds, respectively. Preserve quiet separation and material realism.
prompt_records.evidence: generation prompt recorded with crop SHA

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic single continuous shot, fixed camera, physical cause and target visible. Capture close, detailed, realistic sound synchronized with the visible action, strong enough to suit a dramatic game effect without clipping. No music, speech, voice, chiptune, synthesizers, artificial cinematic risers, cartoon effects, montage, edits or captions. Do not impose three takes: perform one complete event, with a clean natural onset and decay, and leave quiet when the event finishes. One powerful real gust sweeps quickly across tall dry grasses and dust in an outdoor effects area, rises and naturally fades within roughly 0.583 seconds. Record the close air-pressure movement and natural gust, keeping steady fan motor, leaf rustle, speech and unrelated background below audibility. One fluid onset and fade, not three impacts.

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic single continuous live-action scene, fixed close camera with a believable physical sound source visibly moving in sync. Capture bold, physical, close-miked sound with assertive attack, convincing mass and clear texture: fast pressure movement, a decisive sharp transient, weighty mid/low body and a natural short decay appropriate to the material. Strong impact and realistic dynamic range without digital clipping, harsh distortion, cartoon exaggeration or synthetic tones. Three short separated takes of the SAME physical event, with varying force and texture, not copies: weak at about 0.80 seconds, medium at 2.50 seconds, strong at 4.20 seconds. Each take has its own explicit duration below; keep the gaps genuinely quiet and never overlap adjacent tails. Sounds must match what is visible and stop naturally before the next take. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, chiptune, 8-bit sounds, UI sounds, artificial whooshes, cinematic risers, titles, edits or montage. In a real electrical-effects test chamber, a visible short arc snaps between electrodes. Capture its dry electrical crackle and a brief close snap, with no electronic tone. The physical transient peaks at 0.80 / 2.50 / 4.20 seconds, and the complete incoming movement and natural tail last approximately 250 / 380 / 550 milliseconds, respectively. Preserve quiet separation and material realism.

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic single continuous shot, fixed camera, physical cause and target visible. Capture close, detailed, realistic sound synchronized with the visible action, strong enough to suit a dramatic game effect without clipping. No music, speech, voice, chiptune, synthesizers, artificial cinematic risers, cartoon effects, montage, edits or captions. Do not impose three takes: perform one complete event, with a clean natural onset and decay, and leave quiet when the event finishes. A strong local gust lifts dry leaves into one continuous visible outdoor vortex and then the leaves settle. Capture a forceful but natural moving air layer and detailed dry leaf rustle that rise and decay together over roughly 2.417 seconds. No footfalls or continuous motor; do not impose three separate takes.

Before each break, allow about 0.35 s of audible cold ice strain. Fracture peaks at 0.80 / 2.50 / 4.20 s, followed by sharp ice debris decaying for about 0.40 / 0.55 / 0.75 s respectively; leave silence between takes.

Use naturally recorded, close and detailed location/foley audio synchronized to the visible motion. Perform three short distinct occurrences at roughly 0.8, 2.5 and 4.3 seconds; each should vary slightly in force, timing and texture and then stop. Leave a quiet gap and complete the natural decay between occurrences. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, electronic synthesizer, chiptune, 8-bit sound, UI sounds, cartoon sounds, reverb wash, or added cinematic riser. No montage, no cuts, no titles. At an outdoor archery practice range, a real bow shoots an arrow across the frame into a dense straw target. Capture the taut string release, brief air pass and dry fibrous target impact. Use a light recurve bow and a thin arrow: soft short string twang, fine fast air pass, delicate fibrous tick on the straw target.

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic single continuous shot; the visible physical action must generate a clear close, bold, realistic synchronized sound with onset, body and natural decay. No background music, singing, speech, narration, chiptune, 8-bit, synthetic game effects, cartoons, edits, subtitles, digital clipping, or unrelated sound. Avoid unnecessary mechanical hum. Make the action audibly strong enough for dramatic Foley without inventing an inaudible or offscreen cause. A real arrow already in flight strikes and penetrates the center of a synthetic ballistic gel archery target near the start of the shot. A short, sharp aerodynamic pass immediately precedes one convincing close wet-dense piercing thud; retain only its natural brief decay, no second impact or rattling, and no graphic blood. One distinct impact component for later repetition.

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic live-action footage, fixed close camera with the physical cause visible. Use naturally recorded, close and detailed location/foley audio synchronized to the visible motion. Perform three short distinct occurrences at roughly 0.8, 2.5 and 4.3 seconds; each should vary slightly in force, timing and texture and then stop. Leave a quiet gap and complete the natural decay between occurrences. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, electronic synthesizer, chiptune, 8-bit sound, UI sounds, cartoon sounds, reverb wash, or added cinematic riser. No montage, no cuts, no titles. At an outdoor archery practice range, a real bow shoots an arrow across the frame into a dense straw target. Capture the taut string release, brief air pass and dry fibrous target impact. Use a powerful bow and a heavy arrow: deeper string release, strong close air pass and firm low fibrous thud, not an explosion.

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic live-action footage, fixed close camera with the physical cause visible. Use naturally recorded, close and detailed location/foley audio synchronized to the visible motion. Perform three short distinct occurrences at roughly 0.8, 2.5 and 4.3 seconds; each should vary slightly in force, timing and texture and then stop. Leave a quiet gap and complete the natural decay between occurrences. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, electronic synthesizer, chiptune, 8-bit sound, UI sounds, cartoon sounds, reverb wash, or added cinematic riser. No montage, no cuts, no titles. A real irregular stone is thrown across a small outdoor stonework area and strikes a rough slate slab, with a few chips and loose grit scattering. Capture the incoming air and natural solid impact. A fist-sized stone strikes a slate slab with a clear hard crack and a short scatter of small gravel.
prompt_records.evidence: generation prompt recorded with crop SHA

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic single continuous live-action scene, fixed close camera with a believable physical sound source visibly moving in sync. Capture bold, physical, close-miked sound with assertive attack, convincing mass and clear texture: fast pressure movement, a decisive sharp transient, weighty mid/low body and a natural short decay appropriate to the material. Strong impact and realistic dynamic range without digital clipping, harsh distortion, cartoon exaggeration or synthetic tones. Three short separated takes of the SAME physical event, with varying force and texture, not copies: weak at about 0.80 seconds, medium at 2.50 seconds, strong at 4.20 seconds. Each take has its own explicit duration below; keep the gaps genuinely quiet and never overlap adjacent tails. Sounds must match what is visible and stop naturally before the next take. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, chiptune, 8-bit sounds, UI sounds, artificial whooshes, cinematic risers, titles, edits or montage. A wooden striking mallet swings decisively into a dense leather-covered practice pad on a quiet workshop bench three times. Increase the swing strength each time; each blow has a short fast air sweep, solid low contact thump, and tiny natural surface movement. No rocks, no broken timber, no music. Each swing begins about 0.10 s before the pad impact at 0.80 / 2.50 / 4.20 s. The air sweep and impact tail together last about 0.25 / 0.35 / 0.45 s respectively, with clear quiet gaps.

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic live-action footage, fixed close camera with the physical cause visible. Use naturally recorded, close and detailed location/foley audio synchronized to the visible motion. Perform three short distinct occurrences at roughly 0.8, 2.5 and 4.3 seconds; each should vary slightly in force, timing and texture and then stop. Leave a quiet gap and complete the natural decay between occurrences. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, electronic synthesizer, chiptune, 8-bit sound, UI sounds, cartoon sounds, reverb wash, or added cinematic riser. No montage, no cuts, no titles. At an outdoor archery practice range, a real bow shoots an arrow across the frame into a dense straw target. Capture the taut string release, brief air pass and dry fibrous target impact. Use a light recurve bow and a thin arrow: soft short string twang, fine fast air pass, delicate fibrous tick on the straw target.
